name: Grilled rice paper
summary: A crisp rice sheet grilled with toppings, folded and eaten from the paper at the Da Lat night market.
origin: A Da Lat street snack. Visit Lâm Đồng names it with the night-market stalls.
howToEat: Fold the sheet while it is hot and eat it from the paper.
The stall price is Check on arrival.
where: Da Lat Night Market, in the centre. Visit Lâm Đồng puts the stalls at about 18:00–23:00.
seoTitle: Grilled rice paper — Da Lat banh trang nuong
seoDescription: Bánh tráng nướng at the Da Lat night market. Fold the sheet and eat it from the paper. The price is Check on arrival.
